synthesis:draft.headline: AEMO reported a non-credible contingency event affecting the City West transformer in SA1 on 2026-07-30
summary: AEMO reported a non-credible contingency event in the SA region on 2026-07-30 [c1].
AEMO said the City West transformer and a circuit breaker tripped during restoration of another City West transformer [c1].
AEMO stated it did not instruct load shedding and had not been advised of any disconnection of bulk electrical load [c1].
The notice says "The cause of this non credible contingency event is not known at this stage." [c1].

citations.quote: At 1140 hrs, the City West 275/66 kV transformer T_1 and the 275 kV circuit breaker 6675 tripped during restoration of City West 275/66 kV transformer T_2.
citations.supports: Reports that the City West transformer and a 275 kV circuit breaker tripped during restoration; the same notice also says no load shedding was instructed and that the cause is not known.

uncertainties: The notice explicitly states "The cause of this non credible contingency event is not known at this stage." [c1].
The retrieved notices do not include a follow-up incident report or root-cause analysis for the City West event.
missing_evidence: AEMO incident or investigation report giving a post-event cause analysis for the City West trip.
